absent.text: Only an empty chair waits here. Mara’s soul is still in the Counting House.

hello.speaker: mara
hello.text: Do not ask me to make this comfortable. Seris brought me to the vault. Seris helped bring me out. Both belong in the account.

choices.text: Ask what happened at the ferry.
Ask whether she will testify freely.
Tell her she owes us nothing.

ferry.speaker: mara
ferry.text: The collectors came after the flood. They said the bridge toll applied to my boat. I showed them the boundary map. Seris read it. I saw her understand. Then the order came through the mark on her hand, and understanding did not stop her. I remember her shaking. I remember being taken anyway. If you want to write a simple story about a good person forced to do wrong, find another witness. My life was not simple from the other side of her fear.

nothing.speaker: mara
nothing.text: Good. Then we can begin speaking as people instead of accounts. I will decide what I can give. You can decide whether to listen when it is not what you hoped to hear.

testify.speaker: mara
testify.text: I will tell the court what I saw. Not because you rescued me, and not to make Seris feel forgiven. Other people are still in those lanterns. I want the machinery that took us stopped.
